title.en: Chapter 11 — The Stone in the Bird

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: السيدة هدسون فتحت الوزة عشان تطبخها.
sentences.en: Mrs Hudson opened the goose to cook it.
She found inside it a blue stone that shone.

sentences.ar: كانت ياقوتة مسروقة من فندق كبير.
sentences.en: It was a jewel stolen from a great hotel.
And the police were holding a plumber and accusing him.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: ما بحب أحد ينحبس على غلط.
sentences.en: Holmes said: I do not like anyone imprisoned wrongly.
And we placed an advertisement: goose and hat found.
